stories.title: All passengers and crew accounted for after New Orleans boat crash in ‘miracle on the Mississippi’
summary: No passengers or crew were killed or critically hurt after a tanker collided with a river cruise ship on the Mississippi River, officials sayNew Orleans river collision – latest updatesIn what the city’s mayor declared a “miracle on the Mississippi”, all passengers were accounted for – with none killed or critically hurt – after a tanker collided with a river cruise ship docked on the Mississippi River in New Orleans on Friday afternoon.Thirty-two people were taken to local hospitals after the Atlantic Asphalt tanker struck American Cruise Lines’s American Heritage at about 12.30pm – but none of their injuries were considered critical, New Orleans’s mayor, Helena Moreno, said at a news conference.

stories.title: Rip out ugly clutter to help revive UK high streets, says thinktank
summary: Exclusive: Report says restricting cars and freeing up pavement space could be a cheap way to bring shoppers backThe long decline of the high street is a problem that has gripped British governments for years.
But what if there was a solution no one had considered before – doing it all on the cheap?Spending less money is, admittedly, just one element of a report led by the urban thinktank Create Streets.
But it does argue that rather than multimillion-pound revamps, a better answer could be smaller changes aimed at making town and city centres more appealing.
